cohort: Extremely and very preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks of gestational age
finding: Higher gestational age, higher pre-extubation pH, lower pre-extubation FiO2 and PCO2, and lower age at extubation were significant predictors of successful extubation among extremely and very preterm infants.
mod_finding: Infants born via Cesarean section were more likely to have a successful extubation.
